name: Directory
looksLike: a list of places or services I can filter
a website collecting useful resources by category
definition: A website that organizes many listings, such as services, places, or resources, so people can search, filter, compare, and open a useful listing.
goal: Help visitors find a relevant listing and its next action.

sections.name: Search and filters
sections.purpose: Let visitors narrow listings by useful criteria.

sections.name: Listings
sections.purpose: Present consistent facts for quick comparison.

sections.name: Listing details
sections.purpose: Explain the offering, location, and contact options.

sections.name: Submit and maintain
sections.purpose: Let owners suggest updates and explain listing standards.

mustHave: Useful filters and a helpful empty state
A clear correction or reporting route

prompts.short: Build a directory with searchable listings, useful filters, consistent details, and contact links.
prompts.detailed: Build a directory website for people comparing resources or providers. Help visitors find a relevant listing and its next action. Include search and filters, listings, listing details, submit and maintain. Use responsive layouts, clear labels, keyboard access, and visible focus. Consistent listing information.
